'''Guich''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Resistance officer|officer]] who served in the [[Resistance]] as a [[Resistance Army]] [[Captain]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|conflict]] with the [[First Order]]. In [[34 ABY]], Guich was stationed at the [[Resistance base]] on [[D'Qar]]. Per [[Admiral]] [[Ushos O. Statura]]'s request, Guich relayed Statura's order, giving [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]] full authorization for the [[Battle of Starkiller Base|attack]] on [[Starkiller Base]].<ref name="Episode VII" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Guich is portrayed by [[Jeffery Kissoon]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. In the credits, his rank is identified as rear admiral despite wearing an army captain rank in the film. This error in rank was later shown in ''[[Poe Dameron: Flight Log]]''.
